qs.q: Which category of joint pathology is primarily driven by primary degenerative mechanical changes rather than an autoimmune or immune-mediated inflammatory mechanism?
qs.e: Osteoarthritis is fundamentally a degenerative joint disease characterized by cartilage wear and minimal inflammation. Rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and juvenile idiopathic arthritis are all driven by immune and autoimmune mechanisms.
